name: Sonarr Manager
description: Advanced Sonarr management: series browser, season/episode drill-down, quality monitoring, releases, analytics and file management.
author: Arediss

capabilityReasons.permissions: Declares sonarr.view / sonarr.manage so the Sonarr tab can be delegated to a non-admin role.
capabilityReasons.settings:plugin: Stores the storage caps the admin declares per root folder, so reported free space reflects a user quota that the filesystem does not expose.
